producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: The homogeneous EML grammar S → 1 | eml(S,S) has no 1-D integer invariant like polynomial degree. Exhaustive enumeration through 6 internal nodes matches Catalan counts. Two equal-size trees disagree at a registered closed evaluation. Size is therefore not a denotation invariant. US-4′ is not tested.
decision: Accept the constant-grammar census if and only if Catalan enumeration matches and a same-size different-value witness exists. Do not promote US-4′. Cross-size collision is recorded if a well-resolved exact identity is observed and is not a fatal gate.

gates.EFS_SIZE_NOT_DENOTATION: Two trees with the same number of internal nodes have different closed real values. Registered witness: k=2, eml(1,eml(1,1))=e-1 versus eml(eml(1,1),1)=exp(e). Hand identities eml(1,1)=e and leaf=1 must hold.
gates.EFS_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE: The number of trees with k internal nodes equals Catalan C_k for each k in {0,...,6}.
gates.EFS_GRID_COLLISION_DISCLOSED: The summary records that finite-grid / rounded agreement is not function identity.
gates.EFS_US4_PRIME_WITHHELD: The summary flags US-4′ untested. A truncated Gibbs mass is a census statistic, not that claim.

kill_criteria.EFS_SIZE_NOT_DENOTATION: Kill if the registered size-2 pair agrees, or if eml(1,1) is not e, or if the leaf is not 1.
kill_criteria.EFS_ENUMERATION_COMPLETE: Kill if any k in 0..6 has a tree count other than C_k.
kill_criteria.EFS_GRID_COLLISION_DISCLOSED: Kill if the disclosure string is missing.
kill_criteria.EFS_US4_PRIME_WITHHELD: Kill if the run claims US-4′ tested or passed.

optional_gates.EFS_CROSS_SIZE_COLLISION: If two different sizes share a well-resolved closed value via an exact algebraic identity, record it. If not observed, status=withheld. Not fatal.

audit_card.target_object: Closed EML terms: full binary trees with every leaf equal to the constant 1, evaluated as exp(left)-ln(right) on the reals.
audit_card.decision: Accept or reject: Catalan-complete census through k=6; size is not a denotation invariant; US-4′ remains untested.
audit_card.representation: Dataclass trees; real eval with domain y>0; 10-decimal numerical fiber ids for spectrum counts only.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Closed finite language fragment, no sampling, no free variable x.
material_assumptions: The grammar is Odrzywołek's constant grammar, not the variable-leaf calculator language.
Real principal log; nonpositive right-hand arguments and overflow are undefined, not coerced.
Rounded fiber ids are a computational clustering, not an identity theorem.
The leaf-chirality probe (left leaves:=x, right leaves:=y) is a registered representation, not variable-EML.

objects.Tree: full binary trees; leaf denotes 1; internal node denotes eml
objects.C_k: Catalan number; count of trees with k internal nodes

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Closed denotations are real or undefined. No units. Support is the constant grammar through k=6.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: There exist two trees with 2 internal nodes whose closed values differ (e-1 vs exp(e)). For each k in 0..6 the enumerated count equals C_k. US-4′ is not a claim of this package.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Existential for the size-2 witness; universal for Catalan counts on the registered bound.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Real evaluation; overflow/domain failures are undefined; rounding is disclosed and not used for the size witness.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: The size witness uses exact algebraic values, not rounded fiber ids.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Odrzywołek arXiv:2603.21852 for the operator and grammar. No 1-D complete invariant is assumed or constructed.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Pretty-print is a gauge. Closed value is the denotation for this constant grammar.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: k=0 is the leaf 1. k=1 is eml(1,1)=e. Domain failures are undefined. Variable-x grammar is out of scope.

compute.sampling: exhaustive trees with k internal nodes for k<=6 (197 trees). Real eval; nonpositive right-hand side and overflow marked undefined.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as a constant-grammar census through k=6 plus an exact same-size disagreement. Not a variable-x spectrum. Not US-4′. Not an identity theorem for rounded collisions. Not a 1-D invariant.
